mapper.select:
SELECT M.USER_ID AS userId, M.GRP_ID AS grpId, U.NAME AS userName, U.TEL AS tel, U.EMAIL AS email, G.NAME AS grpName, TO_CHAR(M.PRJ_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS prjStartDate FROM USERS U JOIN MEMBER M ON U.ID = M.USER_ID JOIN GRP G ON M.GRP_ID = G.ID
ORDER BY M.USER_ID
SELECT P.PRJ_NAME AS prjName, TO_CHAR(P.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDate, TO_CHAR(P.CLOSED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS closedDate FROM project P WHERE P.ID = #{prjId}

SELECT U.ID AS userId, U.LOGIN AS login, U.NAME AS userName, TO_CHAR(U.HIRE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS hireDate, U.GENDER_CD AS genderCd, U.EMAIL AS email, U.TEL AS tel FROM USERS U WHERE TRIM(U.BIZ_NO) = TRIM(( SELECT P.BIZ_NO FROM project P WHERE P.ID = #{prjId} )) AND UPPER(TRIM(U.STATUS_CD)) = '01ACTIVE'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.USER_ID = U.ID )
ORDER BY U.ID
SELECT G.ID AS id, G.NAME AS grpName FROM GRP G WHERE G.PRJ_ID = #{prjId} AND UPPER(TRIM(G.STATUS_CD)) = '01ACTIVE' ORDER BY G.ID

SELECT M.ID AS memberId, M.USER_ID AS userId, M.GRP_ID AS grpId, G.PRJ_ID AS prjId, U.NAME AS userName, TO_CHAR(U.HIRE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS hireDate, U.GENDER_CD AS genderCd, U.EMAIL AS email, U.TEL AS tel, U.LOGIN AS login, U.LAST_LOG_ON AS lastLoginOn, U.PW_UPDATED_ON AS pwUpdatedOn, P.PRJ_NAME AS prjName, TO_CHAR(M.PRJ_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS prjStartDate, TO_CHAR(M.PRJ_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS prjEndDate, G.NAME AS grpName FROM MEMBER M JOIN USERS U ON U.ID = M.USER_ID JOIN GRP G ON G.ID = M.GRP_ID LEFT JOIN project P ON P.ID = G.PRJ_ID WHERE G.PRJ_ID = #{prjId} AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.GRP_ID = #{grpId} AND (M.PRJ_END_DATE IS NULL OR M.PRJ_END_DATE >= SYSDATE) AND G.STATUS_CD = '01ACTIVE'

SELECT I.ID AS issueId, get_sub_code_name(I.PRIORITY_CD) AS priorityCd, I.SUBJECT AS subject, get_sub_code_name(I.CATEGORY_CD) AS categoryCd, get_sub_code_name(I.STATUS_CD) AS statusCd, RW.NAME AS requesterName, AU.NAME AS assigneeName, I.EST_START_DATE AS estStartDate, I.DUE_DATE AS dueDate, I.START_DATE AS startDate, I.CLOSED_DATE AS closedDate, I.DONE_RATIO AS doneRatio FROM ISSUE I LEFT JOIN USERS AU ON AU.ID = I.MEM_ID LEFT JOIN USERS RW ON RW.ID = I.WRITER WHERE I.PRJ_ID = #{prjId} AND I.MEM_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY I.PRIORITY_CD ASC, I.DONE_RATIO ASC
